layers.label: Endocrine / regulation
layers.anatomy: Hypothalamus, pituitary, pineal, thyroid, parathyroids, adrenals, pancreatic islets, gonads and other endocrine tissues
layers.astronomy_analogy: Seven classical planets as historical astronomical-symbolic classification; not hormone mapping
layers.tradition: Seven double letters in Sefer Yetzirah; modern seven-chakra comparison is separately sourced tradition
layers.book_role: State shifts, physiology, homeostasis, time and rhythm

layers.label: Cranial nerves / perception
layers.anatomy: Twelve paired cranial nerves I–XII; I and II associated with the forebrain rather than emerging from the brainstem
layers.astronomy_analogy: Twelve zodiacal signs as traditional symbolic counting scheme
layers.tradition: Twelve simple letters and diagonal spatial boundaries in Sefer Yetzirah; assigning individual nerves to individual letters is a modern editorial crosswalk
layers.book_role: Observation, sensory input, expression, movement and interpretation

layers.label: Bioelectromagnetism / shadow
layers.anatomy: Electrical potentials and weak magnetic fields from physiological activity; ordinary optical shadows
layers.astronomy_analogy: Magnetosphere, ionosphere and Van Allen belts are independently measured geophysical structures, not homologues of a human aura
layers.tradition: Tzelem and torus imagery as separate spiritual or artistic systems

layers.label: Water / electrolytes / CSF
layers.anatomy: Water compartments and electrolytes; CSF surrounds the central nervous system, not individual vertebral bones
layers.astronomy_analogy: Oceans, aquifers and water cycle; approximately 71% of Earth’s surface is covered by water
layers.tradition: Mem and water imagery in Sefer Yetzirah
layers.book_role: Flow, support, exchange, reflection and recovery

layers.label: Joints / discs / synovial tissues
layers.anatomy: Synovial fluid lubricates synovial joints; intervertebral discs are fibrocartilaginous and are not synovial fluid-filled joints
layers.astronomy_analogy: Faults and tectonic deformation as analogies for strain accommodation, not direct anatomical equivalents
layers.tradition: Tzimtzum from later Jewish mystical thought, especially Lurianic Kabbalah
layers.book_role: Flexibility, boundaries, resilience, space and adaptation

cranial_nerves.name: Vagus
cranial_nerves.primary_function: Autonomic visceral function; voice and swallowing
